messages.author: ee191df8ecbbdcc8
messages.subject: garnett installation
parts:
Hi,

I downloaded monocle and all the dependencies required for installing garnett, however am still running into an issue when I try to install it:

> devtools::install_github("cole-trapnell-lab/garnett")
Error in utils::download.file(url, path, method = download_method(), quiet = quiet,  : 
  cannot open URL 'https://api.github.com/repos/cole-trapnell-lab/garnett/contents/DESCRIPTION?ref=master'

Any way to install using a different path?

Thanks,
Brinda

messages.author: 085d3d5aaca33554
messages.subject: Re: garnett installation
parts:
Hi Brinda,

Sorry the standard installation didn’t work. This appears to be an issue with some settings associated with some windows computers. There’s a long discussion and some fixes discussed here: 
https://github.com/r-lib/remotes/issues/130#issuecomment-423830669

If you just want to get Garnett installed and not worry about the install_github call, you can download and install the package manually by going here: https://github.com/cole-trapnell-lab/garnett clicking the green "clone or download button" and clicking "download zip". When its downloaded and unzipped, you can build and install the package from source by following these instructions: http://kbroman.org/pkg_primer/pages/build.html
 (on a windows computer, this may not work depending on how your environment variables are setup, in which case follow the first half of this to get it set up: https://www.biostat.wisc.edu/~kbroman/Rintro/Rwinpack.html)

Hope this helps,
Hannah
